description: This file defines the PaymentMethod controller class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles API requests for managing payment methods, including validating customer and cart data, setting payment options, and retrieving available payment methods.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class handling API operations related to payment methods in Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles setting the payment method for the current session after validating necessary data.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods based on current customer, cart, and shipping data after validation.
